seo.title: Solutions · Three ways to activate the service system
seo.description: Three ways to activate the service system: we do it for you (end-to-end operation), we control it with you (single view across providers) and we support your expansion (international rollout under control).

hero.subtitle: We do it for you, we control it with you or we support your expansion. You choose the level of involvement; we make sure the service works with quality, control and consistency.

intro.lead: You choose the level of involvement according to your operating model.

execute.intro: We manage after-sales service end to end. We take care of the entire operation to make sure the service runs with quality, speed and control.
execute.closing: You outsource the service. We operate it.

controlTower.intro: We control and improve the service when several providers are involved. We integrate all the information and deliver a single view to make decisions.

pillars.title: What we do
items: Integrate data from in-house operations and external networks

controlTower.closing: One single view for the entire service.

scale.intro: We design the service and help it grow in an orderly way, including internationally. Same standard, same KPIs, in every market.
scale.closing: From designing the service to running it at scale.

capabilities.lead: Three cross-cutting capabilities, active across the three offerings.

items.title: Technical intelligence
items.lead: We turn technical knowledge into practical decisions.
items.closing: We know when something is off and how to fix it.

items.title: Product intelligence
items.lead: We turn the service into useful information for product and procurement.
bullets: We measure impact on cost and quality
items.closing: Every incident informs how to improve the product.

items.title: Service control and compliance
items.lead: We ensure the whole system works and complies.
items.closing: Service does not just happen. It works as it should.
